sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 234080, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: Single site $26, double site $48 a night (2026 and 2027, peak and first-come seasons alike). Additional vehicle $7 a night on the FS page, $8 on recreation.gov.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/brevoort-lake-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night', 'Double Site: $48 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $7 per vehicle per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234080/rates (2026-05-15 to 2026-09-26 and 2027 seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, double 48) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234080 ('Extra vehicle will be charged an $8 per night fee'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/brevoort-lake-campground ('Campground is rustic. There are no hookups for electricity, water or sewer.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Sites numbered 1-70 in the catalog: 33 reservable and 37 first-come (X-prefixed). Catalog vehicle lengths on the 35 sites that list one: 27 at 45 ft, 2 at 40, 5 at 35, 1 at 25; 2 pull-throughs. One RV with tow vehicle per single site; up to 8 people per single site, 16 and 4 vehicles per double.

sites.source: RIDB catalog for 234080 (site names, reservable flag, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/brevoort-lake-campground ('Maximum 8 people per single site, 16 people per double site and 4 vehicles per double site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234080 ('One RV with tow vehicle per single site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Accessible flush toilets and drinking water. RV dump station: the FS page says free for campers and $8 for non-campers but also lists 'Dumpstation Fee: $10 per use'; recreation.gov says $10 per use. Boat launch from the center of the campground on Boedne Bay; day-use picnic area and fishing pier. No office: self-pay station and camp host.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234080 ('accessible flush toilets, drinking water are provided. A dump station is also available for a $10.00 per use fee'; 'We do not have an office at this location. It has a self pay station'; amenities Boat Ramp, Fishing Pier, Host) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/brevoort-lake-campground ('Brevoort Lake is the only campground with an RV dump station. It is free for campers and there is an $8 fee for non-campers', 'Flush toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov or (877) 444-6777 up to 4 days before arrival; 37 of 70 sites are first-come, and the rate table runs a first-come-only week at opening (2026: May 15-21). Weekends 2 nights, holiday weekends 3. A reservation is forfeited if you have not arrived by check-out time the next day; reserved sites cannot be traded for walk-up sites. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/brevoort-lake-campground ('Campground has first come, first served sites and reservable sites', 'Reservations can be made using www.recreation.gov or by calling (877) 444-6777', 'Reservations are forfeited if you have not arrived by check-out time the day after your scheduled arrival') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234080 (facility_rules: reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival', minWeekendStay 2 'Ignore Holidays', minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14 'consecutive days'; notice 'Reservation sites cannot be traded for walk-up sites') + /rates ('First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-15 2026-05-21'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Half-price camping with the Golden Age Passport or America the Beautiful Senior/Access pass; Military Annual and Gold Star Veteran passes cover day-use fees only, not camping.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/brevoort-lake-campground ('Discount passes are honored with ½ price camping only include: Golden Age Passport and America the Beautiful (Interagency) Senior Pass issued to senior citizens and physically disabled citizens', 'Military Annual and Gold Star Veteran Passes are good for covering day use fees ONLY, they do not cover camping fees'), read 2026-10-25

note: Multiple campsites right on Brevoort Lake, about a mile from Lake Michigan.  --AWH  Hiawatha NF campground on a peninsula between Boedne Bay and the rest of 4,233-acre Brevoort Lake, ~20 mi west of St. Ignace off US-2 via FR 3108 and FR 3473; concession-run. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov + RIDB catalog: $26 single / $48 double (2026-2027, confirmed), no hookups (water/sewer added), 70 sites (33 reservable, 37 first-come) to 45 ft with 2 pull-throughs, flush toilets/drinking water/dump, season May 15 - Sept 27, reservable on rec.gov (confirmed) with first-come sites, 4-day cutoff, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night max, senior/access half price. --AWH text kept; dropped the RV Life line (redundant with rating) and the reclassification remark. No alert affects the access roads (an autumn lake drawdown notice only).
